# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Welcome to the Rath. While the single storey cottage or bungalow residence is compact and requires retrofitting, it essentially accommodates an Entrance Hall, Living Room, Kitchen, 3 no. Bedrooms, Utilities Area and Shower Room being set on a generous sized site that extends to approximately 0.67 of an acre or thereabouts statute measure.
